title: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity
question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.

prediction.sql:
WITH delivered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.order_id
  FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
  JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders ro ON co.order_id = ro.order_id
  WHERE ro.cancellation IS NULL OR TRIM(ro.cancellation) = ''
),
order_toppings AS (
  SELECT co.pizza_id, CAST(t.value AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM delivered d
  JOIN pizza_clean_customer_orders co ON d.order_id = co.order_id
  JOIN pizza_recipes r ON co.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
  JOIN json_each(r.toppings) t ON 1=1
),
excluded_toppings AS (
  SELECT co.order_id, CAST(t.value AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM delivered d
  JOIN pizza_clean_customer_orders co ON d.order_id = co.order_id
  WHERE co.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(co.exclusions) != ''
  JOIN json_each(co.exclusions) t ON 1=1
),
extra_toppings AS (
  SELECT co.order_id, CAST(t.value AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM delivered d
  JOIN pizza_clean_customer_orders co ON d.order_id = co.order_id
  WHERE co.extras IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(co.extras) != ''
  JOIN json_each(co.extras) t ON 1=1
),
final_toppings AS (
  SELECT ot.pizza_id, ot.topping_id
  FROM order_toppings ot
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM excluded_toppings et
    WHERE et.topping_id = ot.topping_id
  )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT et.pizza_id, et.topping_id FROM extra_toppings et
)
SELECT tp.topping_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS quantity
FROM final_toppings ft
JOIN pizza_toppings tp ON ft.topping_id = tp.topping_id
GROUP BY tp.topping_name;

role_bindings.evidence: Delivered pizzas are those with a runner order and no cancellation (cancellation IS NULL or empty).
Base ingredients come from the pizza recipe's toppings list, parsed from comma-separated integers.
Exclusions are topping IDs to be removed from the base recipe for that order.
Extras are additional topping IDs added to the base recipe for that order.
The name of each ingredient is stored in pizza_toppings.topping_name.
Total quantity is the count of times each topping appears across all delivered pizzas after applying exclusions and extras.

Parse base toppings from pizza_recipes.toppings for each delivered order.
Combine base toppings (minus exclusions) with extra toppings to get final topping list per order.
Join with pizza_toppings to get names.
Group by topping_name and count occurrences to get total quantity.

Handled exclusions and extras as JSON arrays of topping IDs using json_each.
Subtracted exclusions from base toppings and added extras to get the final set of toppings per pizza.

The join with pizza_recipes and json_each expands each order into multiple topping rows, which is the intended grain for counting toppings.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH delivered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.order_id
  FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
  JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders ro ON co.order_id = ro.order_id
  WHERE ro.cancellation IS NULL OR TRIM(ro.cancellation) = ''
),
base AS (
  SELECT d.order_id,
         CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(co.exclusions,'')) = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_excl,
         CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(co.extras,'')) = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_extra
  FROM delivered d
  JOIN pizza_clean_customer_orders co ON d.order_id = co.order_id
),
recipe_tops AS (
  SELECT r.pizza_id,
         CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM pizza_recipes r
  JOIN base b ON r.pizza_id = (SELECT pizza_id FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders WHERE order_id = b.order_id LIMIT 1)
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS value UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12) x
  WHERE 0
)
SELECT 1

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH delivered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.order_id
  FROM pizza_customer_orders co
  JOIN pizza_runner_orders ro ON co.order_id = ro.order_id
  WHERE ro.cancellation IS NULL
),
orders AS (
  SELECT co.pizza_id, co.exclusions, co.extras
  FROM pizza_customer_orders co
  JOIN delivered d ON co.order_id = d.order_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT o.pizza_id,
         CAST(t.value AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN pizza_recipes r ON o.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
  JOIN json_each(r.toppings) t ON 1=1
),
excl AS (
  SELECT o.pizza_id,
         CAST(t.value AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.exclusions IS NOT NULL
  JOIN json_each(o.exclusions) t ON 1=1
),
extra AS (
  SELECT o.pizza_id,
         CAST(t.value AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.extras IS NOT NULL
  JOIN json_each(o.extras) t ON 1=1
),
final AS (
  SELECT b.pizza_id, b.topping_id
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN excl e ON e.pizza_id = b.pizza_id AND e.topping_id = b.topping_id
  WHERE e.topping_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pizza_id, topping_id FROM extra
)
SELECT tp.topping_name AS name,
       COUNT(*) AS quantity
FROM final f
JOIN pizza_toppings tp ON tp.topping_id = f.topping_id
GROUP BY tp.topping_name;
